add.doc: Add one or more email addresses to the hub blacklist. A single email string is automatically normalized to an array before being JSON-serialized and passed to the blacklist_add stored procedure.

email.doc: Email address or array of email addresses to blacklist. A single string value is automatically wrapped in an array.

data.doc: Result returned by the blacklist_add stored procedure

errors.message: Caller does not have owner permission on this hub

delete.doc: Remove one or more email addresses from the hub blacklist. A single email string is automatically normalized to an array before being passed to the blacklist_delete stored procedure.

email.doc: Email address or array of email addresses to remove from the blacklist. A single string value is automatically wrapped in an array.

data.doc: Result returned by the blacklist_delete stored procedure

errors.message: Caller does not have owner permission on this hub

show.doc: List all blacklisted email addresses for the current hub, paginated via the blacklist_show stored procedure.

page.doc: Page number for pagination. Defaults to 1 when not provided.

data.doc: Paginated list of blacklisted email records returned by the blacklist_show stored procedure

errors.message: Caller does not have owner permission on this hub
